section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure of a single study involving two experimental sessions. Participants first learned a radar simulation task over nine practice and feedback cycles, completing self-efficacy and knowledge tests, and a generalization task. In a follow-up session the following semester, individual-differences measures, including performance trait goal orientations, were collected from the same participants.
